analyst.summary: Anup Engineering makes pressure vessels and heat exchangers for the oil & gas, petrochemical, fertilizer and chemicals capex cycle, and just came off an unusually strong multi-year run - growth has now normalized to a more modest pace, margins have compressed a bit, and the company is currently generating negative free cash flow while receivables from large industrial clients take longer to collect. None of this looks alarming on its own for a capital-goods business working through its order book after a supercycle, but it does mean the historical 26% growth rate is not the right guide to what comes next. We rate this a Hold.
